authentication_notes: Source-file SHA-256 values authenticate the exact supplied files, not an independently downloaded arXiv copy.
Each excerpt records source path, source SHA-256, and inclusive source line range.
Bundle SHA-256 values cover the complete UTF-8 bundle bytes with LF line endings.
The manifest does not include its own hash to avoid self-reference.
global_claim_limit: These papers provide contextual empirical evidence. They do not define or verify Trellis package identity, replay semantics, canonical authority, scientific gates, append-only ledgers, telemetry-derived completion, or canonical event kinds.
